collection_date_note: Sources were observed on Nov 18. Earlier edition dates retain their real HF recommendation or other-source windows; this is a delayed publication.

intro.en: Collection and review bulletin published; no new papers were included. Collection and review record before publication: At this snapshot, HF Nov 18 returned not_ready and explicitly reported available_through Nov 17. This is neither an empty board nor evidence that every source has no update. Complete Nov 17 (41 papers) and Nov 16 (40 papers) boards were also fetched, with all late members and recommendation dates reconciled. All 12 enabled sources were actually attempted on Nov 18 between 09:17 and 09:22 Asia/Shanghai. The strict source window contained 423 occurrences across 388 stable IDs and added 122 new records (103 papers and 19 posts). Seven historical issue paper candidates were separately verified and ingested, bringing total new records to 129 (110 papers and 19 posts), not 129 inclusions. Three arXiv queries returned zero window entries; the five RSS feeds returned 5, 6, 47, 7 and 0. Release checks succeeded for 13 GitHub repositories with no window releases. S2 citations retained 277 window occurrences across 246 IDs, but 46 requests included 15 rate limits and reached a 180-second cutoff. Author identity lookup succeeded but paper traversal was blocked by six rate limits; unvisited coverage remains unknown. The 129 newly ingested identities have item-specific scope findings: 12 inclusion recommendations, 112 exclusions and five evidence deferrals. ESI keeps prompts and skills fixed in its principal experiment; SPG-Select lacks a bound feedback-to-deployed-skill change record; ForgeSystem and RecurIR lack a verifiable deployed Harness artifact chain; the S2 survey remains rate-limited. Positive papers are placed in the true Nov 16 source window or separately labelled historical additions, not presented as new papers in today's bulletin. The historical model evaluation is not complete; recall remains 0.892857 against threshold 0.90. Its warning is retained; no paid model evaluation was rerun and engineering tests are not quality evaluation.
intro.zh: 采集与审核简报已发布，本期未收录新论文。发布前采集与审核记录：截至该快照，HF11/18返回not_ready，available_through明确为11/17；这不等于空榜或所有来源没有更新。已同时复抓11/17全榜41篇与11/16全榜40篇，晚到成员和推荐日全部对账。11/18北京时间09:17–09:22实际尝试全部12路启用来源，严格窗口423次出现、388个稳定ID；窗口新增122条（103篇论文、19篇公告），另核实入库7个历史issue论文候选，总计新增129条（110篇论文、19篇公告），不是129篇已纳入论文。三路arXiv检索均成功返回窗口0条；五路RSS分别5、6、47、7、0条；13个GitHub仓库release检查成功、窗口0条。S2 citations保存277次窗口出现、246个ID，但46次请求含15次429且达到180秒截止；authors只有作者身份查询成功、论文遍历被6次429阻断，未访问覆盖仍unknown。新增129个ID完成逐项范围意见：12个新纳入建议、112个排除、5个待补；其中ESI的主实验固定prompt/skill，SPG-Select缺实际采用技能的反馈修改链，ForgeSystem/RecurIR缺可核验Harness工件部署链，S2综述受429阻断。新的正例分别按11/16真实来源窗口或历史补录呈现，今日简报没有伪造新增论文。旧模型评测recall为0.892857、阈值0.90且评测不完整，告警保留；未重跑付费模型，工程测试不代替质量评测。
